name: vip-gece-admin-mobile
description: VIP GECE admin paneli icin Android APK ve iOS IPA kabu.

scripts.android:debug: cap sync android && node scripts/patch-android-java-target.mjs && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon --no-build-cache assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: cap sync android && node scripts/patch-android-java-target.mjs && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon --no-build-cache assembleRelease
scripts.ios:build:unsigned: cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath build/ios CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY=1 ENABLE_ON_DEMAND_RESOURCES=NO build
